message: 罠

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure what that Arden guy is saying is true.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, he's a brute of a Demon General, but he's not the type to deceive people.」

name: Melilot
message: 「His thought processes and behavior are far too crude, making his value as a fighting force highly questionable... However, the fact that we obtained information on Bylous is valuable.」

name: Arden
message: 「Wha's this thing?」

name: Azel
message: 「That white cylinder is a musical instrument from the Human World.」

name: Azel
message: 「When you press the top, it lets out steam and plays a sound.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Azel, is that not an electric kettle?」

name: Arden
message: 「P-press it? Like this?」

name: Arden
message: 「Hot-cha-cha-cha-cha-cha!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Th-this thing is awesome! All-you-can-drink boiling water anytime, anywhere!」

name: Azel
message: 「The boiling water is merely a byproduct of performing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. Figuring out how to cool that hot water down to a drinkable temperature is a major challenge in the Human World.」
Apparently, Arden had been worked to the bone by Bylous as the heavy-lifting guy, and even during his rare breaks, he was busy courting Pasta.

name: Melilot
message: 「He says Bylous suddenly gained immense power. What this fact implies is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do Demon Generals just suddenly get stronger like that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「While there are species among the Demons that undergo metamorphosis like insects, that likely does not apply to him in this case.」

name: Synn
message: 「If he got stronger by molting or something, he would've been defenseless right before it. But Bylous never had a period like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right. Even Sakura-kun's Demon Lord power is only possible because of his steady daily practice.」

name: Shio
message: 「To become a true master, daily training is what matters most.」

name: Shio
message: 「If one merely imitates superficial tricks as a shortcut, such things are nothing more than a thin veneer.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, it was enough to scare even Arden, so I don't think it's some hastily thrown-together strength.」

name: Melilot
message: 「This does not yet go beyond speculation, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether by coincidence or by design, the power of Re-Crea may have come to dwell within Bylous.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! I-is something like that even possible?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Depending on the Demon General's abilities, it is possible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that unfair? It basically means powering up without putting in any effort yourself」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! It's a total rip-off. It's dishonest, just like cheating on a test. Unforgivable!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... Rather than studying, maybe it's closer to an athlete doping?」

name: Synn
message: 「Neither one is good for the person doing it. Let's warn Bylous and get him to stop」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You are far too good-natured, Sir Synn!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if we talk to him, he definitely won't listen」

name: Melilot
message: 「What we should be most concerned about is... the original Bylous and Re-Crea. The fact that the correlation between these two remains unclear」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff. The scent of cat food is rapidly approaching」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why isn't it sweets? How disappointing」

name: Pasta
message: 「Help me, nyaaaa!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You're!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, it's Macaroni, the Waitress from Prier!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta is Pasta, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, yeah, right, that」

name: Azel
message: 「At this rate, I won't be able to eat」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Pasta, I am disappointed in you」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wh-Why, nya? I ran here for dear life, and you're saying such awful things to me, nya...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ran here? From where?」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, Misa. Pasta is pale as a ghost and trembling. Let's have her sit down and calm down first」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're right, I'll brew some extraordinarily delicious black tea」

name: Pasta
message: 「Thank you, nya, human kindness really warms my heart, nya. Sniff, sob...」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How pitiful... To have the person you have a crush on go mad. *Sniffle*」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even if Pasta's feelings of love didn't reach him, just being able to stay by Bylous-nyama's side made me happy, nya......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it, I totally get it...... *sniff*, *hic*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There, there~. You'll find someone nice someday too, Nana-chan~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even if it was just a work relationship to make Re-Crea bigger, that was fine with me, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Just having Bylous-nyama call Pasta's name made me so happy, nya......」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What a devoted child......」

name: Pasta
message: 「Bylous-nyama is...... not the Bylous-nyama from back then anymore, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「He merged with the power of Re-Crea and became unbelievably strong, nya...... but...... but......!」

name: Pasta
message: 「In exchange, Bylous-nyama went crazy, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「E-Even so, Pasta tried to stay with him, but......」

name: Pasta
message: 「But just now, Pasta got shot at with attack magic, nya! That wasn't Bylous-nyama at all, nya!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Such cruel treatment from the person you love...... *sob*, *hic*......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Sniffle*...... W-What a tragic love!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here, Nana-chan, have a handkerchief~」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, I'll lend you my handkerchief, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「I only have tissues on me......」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta couldn't do anything, nya, so I ran away here, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why you were trembling, Pasta. It's no wonder after going through something like that」

name: Pasta
message: 「Well, not quite, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「The reason Pasta was freaking out was because on the way fleeing here, some mysterious sniper with a forehead 3.5 times the size of a normal person kept shooting at me nonstop, nya」

name: Riesling
message: 「Would that forehead happen to look like this forehead, perchance?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Yeah, just like that, nya--」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wait, gnyaaaaaaaaah!? I'm gonna get kiiiiiilled!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the sniping of Milady's hostile forces to this humble butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Pasta
message: 「S-s-shiver, sh-sh-shake」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san. When you say 'enemy,' that means if Pasta becomes our ally, there's no need to shoot, right?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Indeed it does.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya? You're gonna let Pasta join you, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, the Crusaders' goal is to avert Re-Crea. All we have to do is drive Re-Crea out of Bylous.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanyanya!? Could it be--if we do that, Bylous-nyama will go back to normal, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta will cooperate with you guys, nya. If it's to save Bylous-nyama, Pasta will do anything, nya!」
Pasta joined the party!

name: Riesling
message: 「As there is no longer any need to execute Pasta-sama, I shall return to Type-B guard duty.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「If you will excuse me」

name: Melilot
message: 「Pasta-san, thank you for the valuable information.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Gunya!? Y-you're that obnoxious woman who was tampering with the magic circle awhile back!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I had concealed my presence in order to ascertain the truth of your story...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, thanks to this new piece of evidence, I now have certainty. Confronted with the power of Re-Crea, Bylous has gone mad and is on the verge of going berserk.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, setting a trap will be a simple matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of trap?」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to years of observation, we know that the nexus of the Three Realms lies at Finis Tower.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous is certain to appear there.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And by adapting the magic circle the Demon Generals previously deployed, we should be able to attenuate Re-Crea's power.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will begin preparations at once, so though we are in the middle of a meeting, I must take my leave.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Melilot-san left, but the Student Council room is still just as lively, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「After all, we've gained yet another ally for the Crusaders.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Just over the past two days, we've got Arden and Pasta, huh」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya...? I-I just heard a hideous name, nya... Arden? N-No way... I'm just hearing things, nya...」

name: Arden
message: 「P-P-P-P-Pasta-chan joined our party?! We really are bound by fate, aren't we?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hinyaa?! W-Why are you here--」

name: Pasta
message: 「More importantly, what were you doing earlier when Pasta almost got shot with a gun, nya?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He was hiding behind the sofa. Scuttling right behind it」

name: Arden
message: 「Shh! Shhhhhhhh!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-You're the worst kind of man, nya...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then, Synn-kun. What should we do from here today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see. There's no use worrying any further about the Bylous and Re-Crea, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my, you're surprisingly timid. I'm not even worried about things like the Bylous or Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How are you so full of confidence?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! Isn't it obvious? Because we have the Demon Lord on our side!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm still way too inexperienced, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that?! You swore to me that you'd fight to protect my smile, didn't you!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa~, turns out Synn's actually pretty cheesy」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're secretly jealous though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehehe. That means you'll end up protecting our smiles too, right, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll take it under advisement」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn, you sound like a worn-out salaryman saying that」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, you keep beating me, yet you act so pathetic...」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose it can't be helped! I'll share some of my confidence with you! If it's you, you'll definitely be fine!」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed! There is no way the man whom I recognize as my elder brother could ever lose」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If anyone can save the world, it's you, Synn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, totally. If it's Synn-kun, you can pull it off, right? Just a hunch~」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm-hm. Because Synn-kun is a boy who can do anything if he tries\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it's you, Mr. President, it'll go off without a hitch♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Dunno what's going on, but if it's Prez, no problem-o」

name: Azel
message: 「Well, you know... do your best」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Everyone...!」

name: Misa
message: 「See? Everyone's totally confident in you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course they are, you're my rival, after all. Written as 'worthy opponent' and read as 'rival'! Don't you forget it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」
